latestVersion.changelog:
Image Creator Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate 1080p MP4 videos from uploaded or AI-generated images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, up to 200MB).
- Simple cloud-based setup: automatic token and session management for new users.
- Supports quick, demo-friendly workflows with fast cloud GPU processing (30–60s typical per job).
- Includes commands for uploading, editing, checking credits, status, and exporting videos.
- Shows clear error messages for file size/type issues, credit problems, and connectivity errors.
- Exports high-quality videos and image/audio formats for easy content creation.
